# testdata/antlr

Small ANTLR4 grammars vendored from
[`antlr/grammars-v4`](https://github.com/antlr/grammars-v4) (BSD-3-Clause,
license text preserved in each file's header) to exercise
`../antlr_to_pg.py` without needing network access or a full clone of that
(very large) repository. Copied verbatim, unmodified:

- `json/JSON.g4` — from `grammars-v4/json/JSON.g4`
- `csv/CSV.g4` — from `grammars-v4/csv/CSV.g4`

See `../translate_samples.sh` for how these are used.
